Title: register a new user and delete the account
Preconditions: Browser open, user not logged in, empty cart.
Test Data: Generated unique user (name, e-mail, random password, DOB, address, phone).
Steps:
1. Open the home page and verify it is visible.
2. Click "Signup / Login" and verify "New User Signup!" is visible.
3. Enter a unique name and e-mail and click "Signup".
4. Fill every field of "Enter Account Information" and click "Create Account".
5. Verify "ACCOUNT CREATED!" and click "Continue".
6. Verify "Logged in as <name>" in the header.
7. Click "Delete Account" and verify "ACCOUNT DELETED!".
Expected Result: Account is created, user is logged in with the correct name, and the account can be deleted.

Title: login with correct email and password
Preconditions: A registered user exists (created through the API with a unique e-mail).
Test Data: Valid e-mail + valid password of the registered user.
Steps:
1. Open /login and verify "Login to your account" is visible.
2. Enter the registered e-mail and password and click "Login".
Expected Result: "Logged in as <name>" and "Logout" are shown; "Signup / Login" is no longer in the header.

Title: login with incorrect password shows an error
Preconditions: A registered user exists (created through the API with a unique e-mail).
Steps:
1. Open /login.
2. Enter the registered e-mail with a wrong password and click "Login".
Expected Result: Error "Your email or password is incorrect!" is shown and the user stays logged out.

Title: login with an unknown e-mail shows an error
Preconditions: Browser open, user not logged in, empty cart.
Steps:
1. Open /login.
2. Enter an e-mail that is not registered and any password, click "Login".
Expected Result: Error "Your email or password is incorrect!" is shown.

Title: logout returns the visitor to the login page
Preconditions: A registered user is logged in.
Expected Result: User is redirected to /login, the login form is shown and "Logged in as" is gone.

Title: register with an existing e-mail is rejected
Preconditions: A registered user exists (created through the API with a unique e-mail).
Steps:
1. Open /login.
2. In "New User Signup!" enter any name and the e-mail of the existing user, click "Signup".
Expected Result: Error "Email Address already exist!" is shown; no second account is created.

Title: the password is case sensitive
Preconditions: A registered user exists (created through the API with a unique e-mail).
Steps:
1. Open /login.
2. Enter the correct e-mail with the password in UPPER CASE and click "Login".
Expected Result: Login is rejected with an error: the password is case sensitive.

Title: empty login form is blocked by browser validation
Preconditions: Browser open, user not logged in, empty cart.
Steps:
1. Open /login.
2. Click "Login" with both fields empty.
Expected Result: Browser validation blocks the submit (required field); the page does not change.

Title: signup with a malformed e-mail is blocked by browser validation
Preconditions: Browser open, user not logged in, empty cart.
Steps:
1. Open /login.
2. In the signup form enter a name and the e-mail "not-an-email", click "Signup".
Expected Result: Browser validation reports an invalid e-mail; the signup page is not opened.

Title: signup with an empty name is blocked by browser validation
Preconditions: Browser open, user not logged in, empty cart.
Steps:
1. Open /login.
2. In the signup form leave the name empty, enter a valid e-mail, click "Signup".
Expected Result: Browser validation reports the required name; the signup page is not opened.

Title: a saved session opens the site already logged in
Preconditions: A saved login session (storageState) of the shared user exists.
Test Data: Stored cookies of the shared user.
Steps: 1. Open the home page with the saved session.
Expected Result: The site opens already logged in: "Logged in as <shared user>" and "Logout" are visible.
